design: Two datasets, four paired seeds each, duration 5000/10000 crossed with constant/cosine full policy; 24 actual trajectories supply 32 cells. Cosine endpoints are separate trainings; constant checkpoint reuse is explicit.
model_and_optimizer: Unchanged 296450-parameter float32 reference Denoiser; AdamW lr .0003 and weight decay .01; gradient clip .5; EMA .99/.999 initialized from the raw initial state and updated after every optimizer step.
input_regeneration: Controller independently regenerated initial states, all 10000-step training inputs, held-out draws, generation noise and first-5000 prefix hashes from the frozen reference and declared RNG plan.
training_mode_note: The reference contains no dropout or batch-normalization behavior, so evaluating the constant trajectory at 5000 does not change its subsequent training computation.
